Name: (FS) Limbus Company - Captain Ahab Uniform
Author: silv3rsnow
Description:
[TO-DO LIST: make non-recolourable outfits unable to be recoloured. i have no idea what im doing]
[MODS USED IN SCREENSHOTS: iridium recolours by 6480, dynamic reflections by peacefulend. no pants are included, so i recommend getting a mod that lets you recolour pants]

When I started up the game for the first time, I was out of ideas for what to make my character. For some reason, I decided to make my character Ahab, and it just kinda snowballed into this. I haven't gotten past Year 2 and I'm under 55 hours into the game as of writing, but I have 102 mods and this entire pack made for the bit, so I guess it worked out.

This pack has 9 parts:

Hair
    Captain's Hair
Hats
    Eight Assoc. Uniform
    Eight Assoc. Uniform (Recolourable)
Shirts
    Eight Assoc. Uniform
    Eight Assoc. Uniform (Recolourable)
Sleeves
    Eight Assoc. Uniform
    Eight Assoc. Uniform (Gloves)
    Eight Assoc. Uniform (Gloves) (Recolourable)
    Eight Assoc. Uniform (Recolourable)

If you have any problems, just reply to this mod. Have fun!

(Also, this mod requires Fashion Sense.)
